description.value: Boomerangs Cafe is a locally owned, family-run breakfast and all-day restaurant in Port Alberni that brings an Australian-themed atmosphere to Vancouver Island, owned by Darren and Laura Brown. The menu spans breakfast, lunch, and dinner with Australian touches like Coopers Pale Ale alongside local BC craft beers from four different breweries. It offers dine-in, takeout, and delivery, making it a flexible stop for cyclists passing through the Alberni Valley.
